description:
Get a report that provides the details about which apps and platforms users have used.

TIP: Gets Microsoft 365 Apps usage details per user. The period parameter must be one of: D7, D30, D90, D180. Returns CSV data showing which apps each user used (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote, Teams) and on which platforms (Windows, Mac, Web, Mobile).

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-m365-apps-usage-report
